gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with glioblastoma must have progression of disease after radiotherapy (including patients that undergo surgery for recurrent disease and are rendered NED).

candidate_evidence.quote: All patients will receive a non-myeloablative lymphodepleting preparative regimen of cyclophosphamide and fludarabine. Patients will then receive the infusion of autologous transposed PBL and begin high-dose aldesleukin (720,000 IU/kg IV every 8 hours for up to 10 doses).

candidate_flag.reason: Aldesleukin is given to every patient as part of the cell-therapy regimen (high or low dose); coded soc_backbone, but it could be read as an investigational pharmacological candidate, which would change S6.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: This includes recurrent GBM after receiving all standard first-line treatment, including surgery (if feasible due to neurosurgical and neuro- anatomical considerations) and adjuvant radiotherapy +/- chemotherapy.

role_evidence.quote: Sleeping Beauty Transposed PBL: Day 0: Cells are to be infused at a dose not to exceed 1.5e11 in 400 mL intravenously

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous PBL engineered with Sleeping Beauty transposon to express neoantigen-reactive TCRs (cell/gene therapy)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: The neoantigen TCR gene- modified cells can recognize and destroy the autologous cancer in vitro.

role_evidence.quote: Non-myeloablative, lymphodepleting preparative regimen of cyclophosphamide and fludarabine + Sleeping Beauty Transposed PBL + high- or low-dose aldesleukin.

agents.drug_class_hint: recombinant interleukin-2, given after adoptive cell transfer

source_quote.quote: Exome sequencing and often RNA Seq will be performed to identify the mutations expressed in the patient s cancer.

coder_notes: Multi-cancer basket with a glioblastoma cohort (Cohort 4). Intervention of interest is a TCR-engineered autologous cell/gene therapy (excluded type). Cyclophosphamide/fludarabine are lymphodepleting conditioning (R6, supportive). Aldesleukin coded soc_backbone as fixed part of the ACT regimen (dose high or low). Unnamed oral anti-infective prophylaxis not listed. Neoantigen identification is for TCR manufacture, not an entry selection on a defined marker; role exploratory_correlative is a best fit. Glioblastoma setting coded recurrent (progression after radiotherapy).
